files.title: File:2021-04-16 sj river viaduct 2.jpg
files.author: California High-Speed Rail Authority
files.caption: The completed San Joaquin River Viaduct April 2021. Adjacent is SR-99 and existing railroad tracks. The San Joaquin River Viaduct and Pergola is about 4,741 feet long, and the top of the viaduct is 43 feet wide.

files.title: File:San Joaquin River Viaduct aerial 2019.jpg
files.author: California High-Speed Rail Authority
files.caption: Aerial photograph of California High-Speed Rail's San Joaquin River Viaduct over the San Joaquin River in February 2019.  Original caption: "At the San Joaquin River, crews are installing metal decking over the river, concrete super structure elements are being poured to the south of the river, and deck drainage is being installed on completed sections."
